Due to this character's apparent Italian accent in his dialogues, this NPC's name is probably a double reference to both "veni, vidi, vici" ("I came; I saw; I conquered" in Latin [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veni,_vidi,_vici]) and Joe Pesci's character in My Cousin Vinny, a 1992 American comedy film.
